content.text: Intrigues of the North transports players to the fantasy world created by Andrzej Sapkowski better known as 'The Witcher' universe.

items.text: Completely new map at a different scale.
Play as one of the Northern Monarchs and defend your realm from strife and invasion; or play as the Empire of Nilfgaard and conquer the Nordlings once and for all!
Many new events to reflect the change of the world, such as monster attacks on your people.
Set in a dark-fantasy environment filled with political intrigue.
